# AppConfig

Manage hosted configuration and deploy it immediately to regional environments.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `appconfig` |
| Signing name | `appconfig` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2019-10-09` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Hosted configuration / immediate deployment |
| Selected operations | 31 of 56 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#appconfig) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Only hosted LocationUri is supported; S3, SSM and Secrets Manager retrieval and retrieval roles fail explicitly.
- Validators are stored records and never executed; AWS.AppConfig.FeatureFlags content is accepted without schema or feature validation.
- Strategy durations and bake times are metadata; no gradual rollout, monitoring, alarm rollback or background deployment ticker.
- Extensions, Lambda agent layer, KMS encryption, experiments, account settings and deletion protection checks are unsupported; members outside the profile fail explicitly.
- StopDeployment requires AllowRevert=true because deployment completes synchronously; only the latest completed deployment can be reverted.
- Applications and profiles require child deletion first; deleting an environment removes its deployment history; deployed hosted versions cannot be deleted.
- CloudFormation deletion of Deployment reverts the latest deployment; hosted versions/deployments and trail property changes use replacement; management pages are absent.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
